usedFor: An abandoned Shopify checkout creates a coupon in your WooCommerce store.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: It reacts to a shopper who left without paying, and “Create Coupon” makes the code.

watchOut: “Create Coupon” makes a new code on every run, and it exists only in WooCommerce, not Shopify.
